comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
Follow-up investigation (2026-07-29, session 2) — corrections and evidence:

RACE (proposal 1) CORRECTED: `rebar edit` commits synchronously (write_and_push, event_append.py:549-576) — the field-reported 'EDIT lands after REVIEW_RESULT' deferred-commit mechanism is wrong. Real causes: (a) mid-run `ensure_fresh` reconverge (reads throttled 1/min; _store/sync.py reset-hard/union-merge) pulls any EDIT reaching origin/tickets into the local tracker AFTER the immutable generation was captured at t0 → sign_manifest generation re-check refuses → sidecar stamped with t0 fingerprint → resign refuses forever (resign.py:186-193); (b) split-brain: agent tools read pinned origin/tickets snapshot (repo_snapshot.py:614-633) while fingerprint reads the LIVE local tracker (orchestrator.py:170, relation_snapshot.py:261) — with an unpushed edit the attestation certifies material the model never saw.

BLOCK-VERDICT REUSE (proposal 2, confirmed bug, in scope): skip is structurally PASS-only (claim_gate_check requires a signature; BLOCK never signs, __init__.py:711-717). Sidecar already stamps verified_at_sha on EVERY verdict for exactly this (sidecar.py:600-604); precedent _sidecar_branch_decision (attest.py:337-380). Touch points: _idempotent_reuse/__init__.py:460-508+586-590, latest_review_result, _render_plan_review_text, exit codes; --force already has the right semantics (_llm_commands.py:470-477). Caveat: sidecar findings are slimmed (citations dropped).

CLARITY (proposal 4 superseded): P1 clarity floor landed 07-27 (55f2b8036) and BLOCKS inside review-plan, but only P8 short-circuits the LLM (workflow_ops.py:208-215). Fix: widen the P8 branch (workflow_ops.py:216, gate_dispatch.py:436) to all DET blocks. Backtest on 20 recent closed story/tasks: current floor 0/20 FP; safe blocking additions: verification-presence floor (>=1 AC verify hook OR Testing section) 0/20, vague-lexicon-in-AC 0/20. Keep advisory: spec-by-example (55% FP), riskiest-assumption (70%), compound-AC (85%). NOTE: P1 blocking_fp_proxy 0.875 in criterion_effectiveness.json — review before tightening.

USAGE GAP (proposal 5 corrected): REBAR_USAGE_LOG JSONL DOES capture Pass-1 (runner.py:547 unconditional). Gap is the step-output _usage seam: passes.py:331 drops per-call usage; BatchRunResult has no _usage key → coverage.metrics/CloudWatch have no Pass-1 tokens. Fix: accumulate in run_pass1.

CRITERIA (proposals 6+new): zero findings EVER in ~2,700 reviews: T13 (1,939 agent runs), T14 (1,939), removal-rationale (1,722), asserted-capability (409), hedge (1,724 1-TURN) — DET-gate all five, risk-free. Never-blocking AGENT criteria: T10 (keyword gate: 26% fire rate, 87% recall), T5c (47%/82%; rubric has zero tool directives — also demotable to 1-TURN), T11/T3 (keyword-gate poorly; narrow via applies_at/file-impact or demote), G7/G3/G4 need show_ticket. T1 rubric cites unavailable web tool. Tool-use audit: 13 of 18 AGENT criteria genuinely need tools (G1G2/E4/A1/T8/T3/G7 empirically confirmed). Instrumentation gap: per-criterion request_count extracted (runner.py:_extract_usage) but never persisted.

CACHING (new): Pass-1 design is right (plan in system prompt, byte-identical across all chunk+AGENT calls, passes.py:276-293) BUT no warm-up on the main pool: 6 concurrent cold calls each pay cache-WRITE for the same prefix (pass1.py:438-464) — ~3.7x necessary spend; warm-then-fan-out exists only for container bins (pass1.py:184-232) — port it. No cache TTL setting (Anthropic default 5 min vs ~10-min reviews). Zero cross-pass sharing: 8 prompt_ids each resend the plan; shared preamble ~130 tokens < 1024 cacheable minimum. Fixes: warm-up port, 1h TTL, plan-first common-prefix restructure, thread cache metrics through (same fix as usage gap).

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
Operator scope decisions (2026-07-29):

IN SCOPE / APPROVED:
- Wire clarity floor as a true pre-LLM prerequisite (widen P8 short-circuit to all DET blocks). Backtest of candidate tightenings expanded to last-7-days population (20-ticket sample too small) — in progress.
- BLOCK-verdict idempotent reuse (bug: skip must cover unchanged plans regardless of verdict; re-review only via --force).
- claim --review flag (claim already fails with re-review-needed on stale attestation — verify current behavior). Evaluate edit --review as ergonomics for the edit-then-re-review loop.
- Fix Pass-1 usage step-output gap. Cost accuracy via a maintained pricing library/API (evaluating LiteLLM price JSON, pydantic genai-prices, tokencost, provider APIs) — must cover our multi-provider surface or report honest cost-unavailable for unknown providers; no manually-owned price list.
- T1 prior-art criterion lacking web access is a BUG (pai_tools.py has only read_file/list_directory/search_files/resolve_symbol/show_ticket) — pull web tool access in scope.
- Exhaustiveness directive in the shared Pass-1 finder base prompt (mitigate incremental-depth BLOCK loops).
- Incorporate coaching moves into rebar explain plan comparably to criteria if not already (parity check in progress).
- Pass-1 pool warm-up call (port container warm-then-fan-out): APPROVED.
- Plan-block-as-common-leading-prefix template restructure + wiring so Pass-1/Pass-2 reuse the cached prefix: APPROVED.
- Cache TTL increase: approved IF additional cost small or historical pass-timing data proves the longer window would be used (analysis in progress).

CONDITIONAL / NEEDS EVIDENCE FIRST:
- T5c/T10 demotion to 1-TURN: NOT yet — security/infra findings are sensitive to current codebase/IaC state. First add per-criterion tool-use visibility (persist request_count/tool-call counts per criterion) to confirm whether tool context informs findings or suppresses false positives. T5c 'evaluate the spec AS WRITTEN' rubric language is a suspected bug — the codebase informs the security implications of a plan; surveying how OSS LLM security-review tools handle codebase context. T10 must justify not needing current IaC config — default assumption is it does.
- Four zero-finding AGENT criteria (T13/T14/removal-rationale/asserted-capability): do NOT remove; design conservative DET triggers (validation in progress).
- Five never-blocking criteria (T3/T5c/T10/T11/G7): investigate whether non-blocking findings are noise vs meaningful (possible calibration issue); tighten rubrics to produce better findings before deciding on further gating. Additional DET gates only where strongly aligned + VERY low miss risk.
- Mid-review cancellation on own-material change (stop spending on an already-invalidated plan): feasibility/safety analysis in progress.
- Split-brain reads: understand WHY agent tools pin origin/tickets (commit/ADR archaeology in progress) BEFORE modifying.
- docs code-reviewer 93% drop rate: examine dropped findings to choose between narrowing criteria vs remediating Pass-2.

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
Research round 3 complete (2026-07-29) — evidence for the conditional items:

CLARITY BACKTEST (n=153 tickets, 7 days; 104 passed-plan FP set / 55 blocked-plan hit set, descriptions reconstructed as-of-review): R1 verification-presence floor PROMOTE TO BLOCKING (1-4/104 marginal FP beyond existing P1; 4/4 hits overlapped real blocking findings). R2 vague-lexicon-in-AC: advisory until P6 lexicon regex fixed (\bclean matches 'cleanly'/'clean pass' — 6/8 FPs; add trailing \b, contextualize 'clean'), then re-test at ~1-2% FP. R3 spec-by-example/R4 riskiest-assumption/R5 compound-AC REJECTED as blockers: fire at near-identical rates on good vs blocked plans (76/71%, 86/80%, 51/60%) — no discrimination; belongs in guide/coaching.

T5c/T10 DEMOTION: RESOLVED NO. Zero-blocking is a CONFIG artifact (all five never-blocking criteria carry blocking_enabled:false, threshold 0.95) not a quality signal. Codebase grounding of strong findings: T10 62%, T5c 46% cite concrete repo artifacts (.tf lines, fetch-secrets.sh, network.tf). Tool use per criterion is NOT recorded — add instrumentation (persist per-call request_count/usage into checkpoint+sidecar), but finding-content evidence already shows tools inform findings. OSS survey unanimous: no maintained LLM security reviewer works without repo grounding (Anthropic action mandates repo-context phase + exploitability-proof pass; Semgrep 'exploitability depends on context'; CodeRabbit clones whole repo). T5c 'AS WRITTEN' rubric = confirmed bug; rewrite toward grounded exploitability, keep AGENT. T10 cannot justify skipping IaC state; keep AGENT.

NEVER-BLOCKING FIVE (per-criterion verdicts from ~105 hand-read findings): T3 = calibration, best of five (13/20 class-a, e.g. nonexistent pydantic-ai-slim[retries] extra) → enable blocking @0.85-0.90, no other change. T10 = calibration → blocking @0.90 MAJOR classes + adopt augmented DET gate incl. GHA tokens (28% fire, 100% strong-finding recall). T11 = YIELD problem: post-rollback rubric paragraph is a stock-finding generator (8/21 samples near-identical tautologies vs append-only store) → tighten rubric (fire only on changed interpretation of persisted records; 1-per-plan cap), advisory except demonstrated-data-loss @>=0.9. T5c = NO DET GATE (best keyword gate fires 66% AND misses 5/67 strong findings that are unambiguously real — security findings live in plans without security words); rubric dedup + evidence requirement + blocking @0.90 HIGH classes. G7 = strongest blocking case (11/22 class-a contract contradictions) → blocking for contradicts_reality @0.80-0.85; unresolvable parent → abstain not finding; closed-parent rule.

ZERO-FINDING FOUR — validated DET triggers (regexes in agent report; measured over all 2,705 review-time descriptions): T13 71.0% fire (29% skip), T14 41.8% (58% skip — biggest win), removal-rationale 69.8% (+ file_impact-deletion OR), asserted-capability 75.0% (conjunction module-ref AND capability-verb). Zero recall to lose; conservative by design; implement as _DET_OVERLAY_RULES entries.

MID-REVIEW CANCEL: SAFE with own-material-only predicate. Sign-time generation equality already excludes tracker HEAD + relation snapshot (7c3c08df8/d70a: store-wide equality aborted signing on unrelated writes) — HEAD-keyed cancel would reintroduce d70a. Design: attest.current_material_fingerprint probe under local_read_context at 2 between-pass seams (post-finders, pre-coach), threading.Event checked in pass1._chunk, claimability.indeterminate_verdict('cancelled-stale'), no sidecar, exit 2. Checkpoints keyed by material fingerprint = already orphaned after edit (zero partial credit). Do NOT cancel on related_material (discards reusable checkpoints; sign-time catches it).

SPLIT-BRAIN: understood, both sides correct. Pin = bug fix ec85e4cd5 (agent ticket tools resolved store under code snapshot lacking .tickets-tracker; 26 show_ticket errors → INDETERMINATE); live-local fingerprint load-bearing (must re-validate under live store write lock; pinned-copy fingerprint would never go stale). Residual: locally-edited-unpushed CHILD reviewed old-text by agent / new-text by DET+pins, signature binds new; nothing detects skew. Action: document divergence + add skew detection, do NOT unify roots.

VERBS: claim already fails closed, exit 1, actionable message (gates.py:209-217) — confirmed. edit --review: RECOMMEND, ship first (edit mutates exactly the fingerprinted fields; single process makes ordering unskippable; complements cancel — same own_material helper). claim --review second (hook at claim.py:133; accept ms-scale fail-closed TOCTOU; do NOT propagate through parent cascade). Both foreground, CLI-only, documented non-atomic vs reconverge.

PRICING: genai-prices primary (MIT, pydantic vendor alignment — pydantic-ai RequestUsage implements its AbstractUsage; cache read/write tiers; historical prices by timestamp; bundled offline data; typed LookupError → honest 'cost unavailable' incl. fake runner). Repo-local overlay JSON (litellm field vocabulary) for brand-new models. Extend usage_log rows with model/provider/UTC timestamp; label column 'est. cost'.

COACH PARITY: confirmed bug — guide is criterion-complete, move-blind (zero of 15 moves named; no rebar explain <move>). Top-5 gap (360 field hits): spec-by-example 150, observable-proxy half of plan-the-verification 96, riskiest-assumption 51, [operator-attested] tag 41, propagate-to-children 22. Fix: 'Responding to coaching moves' section keyed by move name, frequency-ordered.

DOCS REVIEWER: structural dead end — docs-only findings have NO path to surface (nit_suppressed + blocking_enabled:false); 47/125 nit-suppressed had validity>=0.8 AND impact>0. Both fixes: (1) impact-aware nit suppression (suppress only impact==0) at workflow_ops.py:443-446; (2) rubric forbids absence speculation (95 absence-refuted drops = correctly rejected but billed).

TTL: RECOMMEND STAYING AT 5 MIN. Refresh-on-hit + measured inter-pass gaps ~50-100ms mean the 5-min window covers the entire review (87% of reviews >5min total but no gap approaches 5min). 1h premium buys nothing cross-review (revise loops change prefix bytes). Investment → approved plan-first prefix restructure. Secondary: gate runs use MemoryRecorder, per-step durations discarded — persist if pass timing matters.

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
Operator decisions round 2 (2026-07-29):

APPROVED / IN-SCOPE: R1 verification-presence floor (blocking). Mid-review cancellation (own-material predicate design). edit --review + claim --review flags. genai-prices — as OPTIONAL add-in with graceful fallback when not installed (cost column reads unavailable, never an error). T5c rewrite to field-consistent code grounding. Coaching moves into plan guidance. Docs suppression fix — valid doc findings being suppressed is a bug; do not block on nits, but doc quality meaningfully impacts codebase accuracy and future-agent success (impact-aware suppression direction). DET triggers for zero-finding criteria — pending counter-example/false-negative audit (in progress). T3 + T10 blocking enablement. T5c threshold @0.90.

REJECTED / DESCOPED: Split-brain remediation — narrow edge case given push-on-ticket-change policy; high risk of unintended regression. T11 one-per-plan cap — rejected; keep only the interpretation-change constraint, and it MUST be portable across diverse stacks (no rebar-specific anti-FP language).

PENDING DATA (agents running): R2 fixed-lexicon regex backtested against history now (no advisory waiting period if data supports blocking). DET trigger evasion analysis (bias toward firing; silent never-evaluate is the failure mode). G7 threshold FP verification before enabling contradicts_reality blocking. T5c rubric-tightening necessity check vs existing Pass-2 validity/impact filtering.

T11 PORTABLE CONSTRAINT DRAFT (stack-agnostic): raise post-rollback-state findings ONLY when the plan (a) changes how existing persisted records are interpreted, (b) rewrites/migrates records in place, (c) removes or narrows a read path, or (d) performs a one-way transformation with no back-out. Do NOT raise for purely additive, backward-compatible persistence changes that existing readers ignore (new event/record types, optional fields, new tables/columns with defaults) — in append-only or backward-compatible systems, residual data after rollback is the norm, not a risk. No store-technology named; applies equally to SQL migrations, event stores, document DBs, config formats.

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
Cross-session finding (epic 061c provider-seam run, recorded here for the plan-review ledger): the gates are strong on code-grounded claims and structurally blind on world-grounded ones.

WHAT THE RUN SHOWED: plan review blocked every repo-checkable infeasibility (boto3-retry mechanics, unimplementable isinstance, billable canary, Converse/InvokeModel mismatch); completion verifier caught missing tests twice; preflight caught 2 regressions. Four escapes, all one class — green signals whose measurement could not have observed the claimed failure: (1) measurements from the wrong AWS account/region recorded as fact; (2) validation under bedrock:* privilege (evidence generated under broader privilege than production cannot fail, so success carries no information — role-scoped simulation later showed implicitDeny in production); (3) two vacuous tests (caught by mutation testing + reviewer — repo-checkable, hence catchable); (4) confidence outrunning method (hand-grep reported as verification; green reported while typecheck red).

WHY THE GATES MISS IT: [operator-attested] (ADR 0043) requires provenance of the attestation EVENT (change id/vote/timestamp), not of the MEASUREMENT (account, region, principal, privilege scope). Plan review runs before evidence exists; the completion verifier accepts attested evidence on trust by design. verified_at_sha pins the code world completely and the outside world not at all.

IMPLICATIONS / RECOMMENDED SHAPE (fits existing patterns; new scope beyond this epic — belongs with epic 9109, filing owned by the 061c session):
1. Extend the attested-evidence contract with measurement-provenance fields: environment id, principal, privilege posture vs production (production-equivalent / broader / narrower). Enforce PRESENCE deterministically (det_operator_attested.py-style lint, zero LLM).
2. Once provenance is declared, the wrong-account class becomes repo-checkable: an LLM criterion that reads infra/ and docs can flag declared-account/region contradicting the project's own environment facts (same shape as T10 grounding).
3. New advisory criterion, corpus-calibrated per ADR 0054 before any promotion: an AC verified against an external system must state the identity, privilege, and environment of the verification and why that context can exhibit the failure. Generalizes E4's "cached knowledge is not a substitute" to the world; the evidence-side analog of what mutation testing does to vacuous tests.
4. Anti-recommendation: do NOT have the completion verifier re-run world measurements — expensive, flaky, and the verifier's own credentials recurse the privilege-masking problem. Force provenance into the record; let review compare declarations against repo facts.
5. Reporting-discipline note (not a gate gap): reported-green-while-red is an orchestration honesty failure; agents must relay gate output faithfully.

Extracted rule (061c session's wording, endorsed): evidence produced under broader privilege, or in a different environment, than the thing being tested is not evidence.

compiled_state.description:
Evidence-backed proposals to cut LLM token spend without weakening the gates. Full analysis in the session that filed this ticket; headline evidence:

EVIDENCE (rebar tickets branch, Jun 23-Jul 29): 2,683 plan reviews / 779 tickets (mean 3.4, 71% re-runs, ~66k LLM calls, ~319 LLM-hours). Challenge repo (sec-semantic-layer, wk of 07-22): 545 reviews / 121 tickets, 70% needed 2+. Re-run causes (rebar store): 57% BLOCK->revise (intended), 22% staleness (13% self-edit-after-PASS, dep/base/registry drift), ~12% pure waste (117 unrevised-BLOCK retries, 114 identical-material re-runs incl. PASS<->BLOCK flapping on identical fingerprint+sha).

Already fixed upstream (do NOT redo): depends_on INDETERMINATE envelope bug (60a0eab88, 966f7cff3); container over-invalidation (f0cf30a0e); registry grandfathering (ADR 0053); trivial-rebase carry (ADR 0041); artifact dedupe (1bed2f0cd); temp-0 Pass-2 verifier (dcfcb15b4); prompt caching; budget cap+shedding; checkpointing; idempotent skip; --status; sign-review; claimability fast-fail; drift-refresh probe.

PROPOSALS (no model changes):
1. Fix the edit&&review-plan write race (EDIT commit lands after REVIEW_RESULT, voiding the fingerprint; only doc-warnings + resign rescue exist today). Sign on current-material==reviewed-material regardless of event order, or provide an atomic verb.
2. Deterministic verdict reuse for identical fingerprint+sha when last verdict was BLOCK (idempotent skip covers only valid PASS). Kills unrevised-BLOCK retries and makes verdict flapping cost-free (~3k calls in-store).
3. review-at-claim discipline: run review-plan only immediately before claim (a claim --review combined verb; next-batch aware). 245 self-edit-after-PASS re-runs + ~10.3k calls spent on never-landed tickets.
4. Author-side deterministic preflight for the chronic blockers: P6 ac-quality failed in 456/540 challenge reviews; G6/G1G2/E4 + specification-by-example dominate BLOCKs. A zero-LLM lint (existing _lib_gates checks) surfaced pre-review would shorten the 57% BLOCK->revise loop.
5. Close the Pass-1 usage-log gap (ed8c747e8 notes it) + real price table (COST_AGENT_USD=0.12 is a hard-coded guess) so the USD cap reflects reality.
6. Demote AGENT-exec criteria to 1-TURN where the ADR-0054 corpus replay shows tool exploration never changed the finding: 18 AGENT criteria at ~20x 1-TURN cost dominate per-review spend (~26.5 calls/review).
7. Optional, validate first: extend temperature-0 (or warm-then-fan-out caching) to Pass-1 finders; flapping on identical material observed (epic bbf1: PASS,PASS,PASS,BLOCK,PASS).

Explicitly NOT proposed: model swaps (context-window/capability changes alter gate behavior; ladder + sonnet verifier already tuned).
